conclusion: Based on available evidence, Eli Stone is the most likely responsible individual for the missing prototype. He had documented motive (requested prototype at 17:00), was observed with the prototype in service corridor at actual time 18:14 (V04/V10 showing 18:19 due to +5 min offset), and entered via service door at 18:14 (D01). The service corridor provides unmonitored access to lab per V01 schematic. Other staff were documented in separate locations during the critical window (V03/V06/V07/V08). However, limitations exist: coat color is appearance evidence not biometric verification per D03_messages; location snapshots do not establish continuous whereabouts; badge credentials log access but not identity per D03_messages. Alternative explanations remain plausible including unauthorized use of service corridor by unknown person or timing gaps between observed locations.
